title: Nothing Beats a Jet2 Holiday
blurb: Nothing beats a Jet2 holiday. It is a perfectly ordinary British package-holiday advert, and the ordinariness is what makes it such good raw material. TikTok pairs that serene voiceover and sunny backing track with footage of holidays collapsing: wasps at the beach bar, suitcases exploding on the carousel, hotel corridors filling with water. The comedy is pure tonal dissonance, and the supply of holiday disasters is infinite and self-renewing. The phrase has escaped the internet entirely — you will now hear it said out loud, in person, the moment anything goes wrong near a swimming pool.
origin: From Jet2's TV advert; viral on TikTok as ironic backing for holiday disasters.
